latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of LogClip.

- Enables filtering of timestamped log entries between specific date ranges from raw or unstructured log text.
- Supports custom timestamp patterns for flexible log parsing.
- Allows output timestamp reformatting with user-defined formats.
- Works with both stdin and file inputs for convenient integration.
- Simple command-line interface for fast and easy usage.
